title: Case Definition Schema
description: Complete schema for medical mystery case definitions in the Satori Internal Affairs system. Defines the contract between Anamnesis (case generation) and Satori (case execution).

id.description: Unique identifier for this case (UUID format)

version.description: Semantic version of the case definition (e.g., '1.0.0')

action_costs.description: Time costs for each action type in minutes

nodes.description: The atomic units of the simulation - every piece of case reality is a node

Metadata.description: Case metadata including difficulty, learning objectives, and content boundaries

estimated_duration_minutes.description: Expected real-world time for a player to complete this case

simulated_duration_minutes.description: Total simulated time span of the case in game minutes

learning_objectives.description: Educational goals and clinical lessons this case teaches

dramatic_tone.description: Primary narrative tone and focus of the case

content_boundaries.description: Content warnings or boundaries (e.g., 'no graphic violence', 'contains death')

PatientContext.description: Patient identity and presentation information. Narrative layer for Internal Affairs display, with age/sex medically relevant for Satori.

setting.description: Clinical setting where case takes place (e.g., 'Emergency Department', 'Outpatient Clinic')

chief_complaint.description: Why the patient is seeking care

appearance.description: Physical appearance and presentation of the patient

backstory.description: Brief contextual background - NOT directly revealed to player, used for narrative consistency

arriving_vitals.description: Baseline vital signs on patient arrival

VitalSigns.description: Patient vital signs. All fields optional - nodes only declare vitals they affect. Satori computes current vitals as worst value across active nodes and baseline.

heart_rate.description: Heart rate in beats per minute

respiratory_rate.description: Respiratory rate in breaths per minute

GroundTruth.description: Clinical truth about the case - never revealed to player during gameplay, used for outcome evaluation and teaching debrief

differential.description: Alternative diagnoses that should be considered

key_insight.description: The critical reasoning or discovery needed to reach the correct diagnosis

optimal_path.description: Ideal sequence of actions to solve the case

critical_time_minutes.description: Time limit before irreversible harm occurs (null if no hard deadline)

narrative_hooks.description: Dramatic and teaching elements woven into the case structure

OptimalStep.description: A step in the optimal solution path

description.description: Why this action is part of the optimal path

time_minutes.description: Cumulative time from case start when this action should occur

NarrativeHook.description: A dramatic or teaching element embedded in the case

description.description: What this hook adds to the case

structural_role.description: How this hook connects to the node graph and case mechanics

TimeCost.description: Time cost for performing an action

action_minutes.description: Time to perform the action itself

result_delay_minutes.description: Additional time until results become available (for labs, imaging, etc.)

Node.description: Atomic unit of simulation. Every piece of case reality is a node with its own lifecycle.

id.description: Unique identifier for this node within the case

type.description: Category of node determining its role in the case

content.description: Narrative payload - what the player sees/reads

activation.description: When this node becomes live in the simulation

reveal.description: How the player discovers this node (null for auto-revealed nodes like progressions)

timer.description: Countdown from activation driving time pressure (null if no timer)

vital_signs.description: Vital signs this node wants when active (contributes to worst-case computation)

effects.description: What happens when this node activates, reveals, expires, or gets intervened on

outcome_weight.description: How this node contributes to final case scoring

teaching_note.description: Teaching point associated with this node (for debrief layer)

NodeContent.description: Narrative payload of a node. In Phase 1, text is frozen. In future phases, narrative_text may be dynamically generated while structured_data remains frozen.

narrative_text.description: What the player reads when this node reveals

structured_data.description: Machine-readable medical data (lab values, measurements, etc.)

stage_narratives.description: For progression nodes with multiple stages, narrative for each stage

StageNarrative.description: Narrative for a specific timer stage in a progression node

stage_index.description: Which stage this narrative belongs to (0-indexed)

ActivationRule.description: Defines when a node becomes live. OR between paths, AND within each path.

paths.description: Node activates when ANY path is satisfied (OR logic)

on_activate.description: Effects that fire when the node activates

starts_active.description: If true, node is active from case start

ConditionPath.description: A single path of conditions that must all be met (AND logic)

conditions.description: All conditions in this path must be true for path to be satisfied

Condition.description: A single condition that can be evaluated true or false

target.description: What to check: flag name, node ID, vital name, etc.

value.description: Threshold value for comparisons (time in minutes, vital value, etc.)

RevealRule.description: How the player discovers this node

action.description: Action type that reveals this node

conditions.description: Additional conditions required beyond just performing the action

auto_reveal.description: If true, reveals automatically when active without player action

delay_minutes.description: Time between action and reveal (for lab results, imaging, etc.)

NodeTimer.description: Countdown timer from node activation, driving time pressure

stages.description: Progressive effects at specific time points

on_expire.description: Effects that fire when timer reaches zero

TimerStage.description: Effects that occur at a specific point during a timer countdown

at_minutes.description: Minutes after activation when this stage triggers

effects.description: Effects to apply at this stage

NodeEffects.description: Effects triggered by node lifecycle events

on_reveal.description: Effects when node is revealed to player

on_intervene.description: Effects when specific intervention is applied

InterventionEffect.description: Effect triggered by a specific treatment or intervention

treatment.description: Name of treatment that triggers this effect

effects.description: Effects to apply when this treatment is given

Effect.description: A single effect that modifies game state

target.description: What to affect: flag name, node ID, action type, etc.

value.description: Value for the effect (minutes for timer modification, vital values for override, etc.)

OutcomeWeight.description: How this node contributes to final case scoring

impact.description: Weight of this node in outcome evaluation

scoring_notes.description: Notes about how this node should be scored

OutcomeEvaluation.description: How the case is scored at resolution

tiers.description: Outcome tiers from optimal to failure

harmful_actions.description: Actions that harm the patient and incur penalties

end_conditions.description: Conditions that can end the case

OutcomeTier.description: A specific outcome tier (optimal, good, partial, failure)

required_flags.description: Flags that must be set for this tier

excluded_flags.description: Flags that must NOT be set for this tier

TimeConstraint.description: A flag must be set before a certain time

before_minutes.description: Time limit in minutes from case start

HarmfulAction.description: An action that harms the patient

flag.description: Flag that indicates this harmful action was taken

penalty_note.description: Explanation of the penalty or harm caused

target.description: Target for the condition (node ID, flag name, etc.)

value.description: Value for the condition (time in minutes, etc.)

description.description: Description of what this end condition represents
